title: On-Demand Payout Availability Across Northloop Payments Plans
content:
Whether a seller may request an extra standard payout outside the schedule, and the minimum number of hours between two on-demand payouts, are terms of the Northloop Payments payout plan.

| Payout plan | Payments Starter | Payments Biweekly | Payments Weekly | Payments Daily | Payments Daily Plus | Payments Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| On-demand payouts allowed | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Minimum hours between two on-demand payouts | not applicable | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |

- The on-demand interval is the minimum number of hours between two on-demand payouts; it is not applicable on a plan without on-demand payouts.
- Payments Starter does not allow on-demand payouts, so no interval is set for it. Every other plan allows them with an interval of 24 hours.

**Questions answered by the table**

*Does Payments Starter offer an extra payout outside the schedule?* No; the plan does not allow on-demand payouts.

*What interval applies on Payments Daily Plus?* 24 hours between two on-demand payouts, the same as on Payments Biweekly, Payments Weekly, Payments Daily and Payments Enterprise.
